text: It can still take several more months to know the full benefit of treatment. With that said, if you are tolerating the finasteride/minoxidil combination without side effects, I would encourage you to continue a bit longer before deciding that it is not helping.

We should be able to change you to the chewable finasteride/minoxidil combination without difficulty. First, have there been any changes in your health or medications since your last check-in? Second, are you comfortable with the higher quarterly price that comes with that change?

I did review the photos you submitted, and I do not see anything suggesting an alternate cause of hair loss such as inflammation or scarring. If you are interested, we can discuss changing from finasteride alone to a combination option that also includes minoxidil to improve effectiveness.

Since this medication is generally safe to use either daily or as needed, the choice is mostly a matter of preference. The main advantage of daily treatment is that it does not need to be timed before sex, whereas as-needed treatment can work well if you prefer to take medication only when you expect to need it.

We can change your prescription back to the tadalafil/fluoxetine combination that you were taking previously if that regimen worked better for you. If you want to make that change, please confirm that there have been no changes in your health or medications since the last prescription.

One of the required safety labs was not able to be completed from the first sample, while the other results were reassuring. We do need that remaining lab before treatment, so you will be sent another collection kit and we will follow up again once that result is available.
I see that you reported wanting birth control for a reason other than pregnancy prevention. Is that correct, and if so, what is the main reason you are hoping to use it?

Before I move forward, I need to clarify whether you are taking any medications for blood pressure at this time. If you are, please let me know which medication and dose so I can review that with the rest of your chart.
I will go ahead and write the prescription now. The pharmacy may still need some time to process it, but we can flag it to be handled now rather than waiting until the next scheduled shipment.

S: Patient requests change from daily treatment to as-needed dosing and reports no interval changes in health or medications. A: Erectile dysfunction, stable. P: Change treatment to tadalafil as needed, review dosing instructions and maximum frequency, prescription written, follow-up per routine.
